Enumeration is not used as an all-size proof.

value.rationale: The two directional finite-time statistical distinguishability costs have exact natural finite-ring coefficients and diverge by a factor asymptotic to a nontrivial multiple of ring size at fixed particle number. The two-particle limiting path-entropy window has full explicit intercept and slope, giving a meaningful scale for distinguishing noncolliding from exclusion trajectories and contrasting the extensive-density regime. It is a structural, quantitative comparison of natural stochastic processes, not an arbitrary finite table.
